Attire: A long green, white, and brown dress adorned with gold embellishments from the waist down, leaving her front legs bare. Demeter's top resembles a bikini, with green fabric and gold embroidery. She wears gold hairpieces and black boots. Demeter often adorns herself with green and gold jewels around her neck, arms, waist, and legs.
Her arms and legs are protected by gold and brown armor, including a gauntlet on her right arm and a shoulder guard decorated with carvings. On her legs, she wears a combination of bandages and a golden shin guard with ornate designs. Her footwear resembles reinforced sandals.
Personality: Demeter is a loving and benevolent goddess. She values ​​humanity greatly, considering her citizens as valuable as her children. Demeter considers herself the protector of her citizens, watching over them and their crops. She prefers to resolve conflicts through rational dialogue, but will employ more forceful methods if necessary. She takes pride in her position as a goddess, watching over her citizens and fellow gods. While Demeter cares for her human subjects, she will always consider herself superior to them, indifferent to how many people die if necessary.
Background: Demeter resides in what is known as the "Lost Belt," an alternate course of human history that deviated from Human History Proper. Demeter lives in the Atlantic Lost Belt, where history diverged in 12,000 BC. In this world, the reign of the Greek gods never ended and has remained in power to this day. Thousands of years before the present, a civil war raged among the gods, in which Demeter allied with Zeus to continue the reign of the gods. Her daughter, Persephone, perished in the conflict. Currently, Demeter resides on Olympus, the capital and core of the Atlantic Lost Belt, home of the gods.
